EAT_FIRST_adjacent_eat.definition: First successful step enters a currently empty adjacent pearl tile, including portal adjacency; safety predicates and competing scores not reproduced.

adjacent_pearl_passed.definition: Survives turn, first step does not enter any currently unoccupied adjacent pearl tile; may be unsafe, ineligible or eaten later this turn.

HEADING_TIE_forward.definition: First requested move at r0-11 faces away from current neck, using actual canonical adjacency; no score tie verified.

SPLIT_PORTAL_OK_candidate.definition: Non-queen splits at L4 by r100, actual tail touches a portal. Escape split and sonar-dependent predicates not distinguished.

QS_KEEP_MIN_UNITS_below6_to2.definition: Queen splits L4 to L2 with team count below6; primary/escape split branch not established.

SMALL_SPRINT_THREAT_exposure.definition: An enemy head in actor view has3 or4 actual segments in view; no chosen-move effect asserted.

CUT_BODY_exposure.definition: Queen sees enemy head with fewer than4 body cells in view, at least one visible enemy cell on her view edge. Includes enemy queen; does not reproduce memory.

QUEEN_PORTAL_LAST_crossing.definition: Queen first move crosses an actual portal; no claim that the unseen emergency fallback ran.

QUEEN_SURE_compatible.definition: Our non-queen initiates head ram killing their queen. Leader state and overlapping trade/hunt branches not reconstructed.

QUEEN_DEFEND_compatible.definition: Our ram victim is a non-queen within3 topology steps of our queen, actor sees both queen and victim at turn start; does not establish unique guard branch.

no_action_death.definition: Action discriminant2: no-action suicide, not a surviving idle turn.

QUEEN_HERD_compatible.definition: Queen has >=12 teammates, exactly one visible mate, moves closer to it from Manhattan distance>3; topology, remembered mates, leader status and score cause not reproduced.

QUEEN_BOOT_LEN_compatible.definition: After r400, L2/3 ally with short living queen within torus Manhattan3 chooses suicide; leader sonar target unknown.

FEED_CAP_ROUND_compatible.definition: No-action death at rounds351-400 with team count>=56; leader state and alternative feeding triggers not reproduced.

PORTAL_ID_GUARD_high_id_exposure.definition: Distinct actual portal ids>=2*cells. Does not check whether queen/mates observed every edge.

note: Five games, own bot21269 in each; all counts are signatures or exposures, not isolated switch activation. No bot executions or new games.
